t: This is the Bishops House in Southwark, a house designed by Richard Norman Shaw. Shaw was a British architect who worked from the 1870s to the 1900s, and he is considered among the greatest of British architects. He was known for his country houses and for commercial buildings, and his influence on style was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s. The material I have on this particular house is thin, so take a moment to look at the building itself and see how it sits in its street.
